events.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
events.summary: Hi everyone!Until It's About Pirates is officially Steam Deck Verified, I wanted to clarify what you can expect.The game should run well on the Deck! It has full controller support for gameplay and menu navigation.At Max settings I experienced solid performance: 60 FPS most of the time, with occasional drops into the 50s. For extra headroom or longer battery life, try reducing the quality level to Medium or turning off heavy settings like water reflections.If you notice any issues, please let me

events.title: It's About Pirates - Demo available now!
events.summary: It's time to set sail in the It's About Pirates demo. But first, let me say thank you to the over 5000 people who have already wishlisted the game! What awaits? The demo will take you to a pirate realm called Windward Waters. You get 10 rounds to shape your build before facing the first boss of the game.
